title: Boissière Village, #1 Saddle Road, Maraval - My Bunch of Keys
description: ✨ FOR SALE: SADDLE ROAD, BOISSIÈRE VILLAGE ✨ “A prime fixer-upper with high-visibility!” Situated in a landmark position along Saddle Road in Boissière Village, this two-storey fixer-upper offers an exceptional blank canvas for visionaries and investors. Set on 5,125 sq. ft. of freehold land with 2,915 sq. ft. of interior space, this property boasts high-traffic exposure—making it ideal for a complete custom restoration into a corporate office, medical clinic, boutique store, or unique residential space. The building is currently divided into two separate spaces. The upper floor features 3 bedrooms, a living room, kitchen, bathroom, and a private porch overlooking the area. The ground floor consists of 2 bedrooms, a spacious living area, kitchen, and bathroom. With classic architectural character, a secure gated layout, and a large paved courtyard for client or resident parking, this property is a rare find for strategic investors looking to build in a prime area.
